sloka: कथं नु खलु दुष्पारं तरिष्यन्ति महोदधिम् ।तानि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि तौ वा नरवरात्मजौ ।। ५.६८.८ ।।।।
transliteration: kathaṁ nu khalu duṣpāraṁ tariṣyanti mahodadhim ।tāni haryṛkṣasainyāni tau vā naravarātmajau ।। 5.68.8 ।।।।

translations.english: 'How will the vanaras and bears cross this great, impassable ocean? How will the princes Rama and Lakshmna be able to cross it?
